newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint closes $200 mln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint closes $200 mln credit pact.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Friday it has completed a $200 million credit agreement which will allow the company to expand its operations.

This five-year facility replaces Brightpoint's credit facilities that provided for $125 million of available capital. The company's borrowings under these facilities were about $98.8 million as of June 25, 1997.

Brightpoint said the new agreement allows it to borrow in multiple currencies and will be used for the working capital needs of the company on a global basis, as well as for certain capital expenditures and potential acquisitions.

"This new facility offers us attractive financing costs and cash management efficiencies as we work with our new banking partners in various countries throughout the world," said Phillip Bounsall, Brightpoint executive vice president and chief financial officer.

Lenders include First National Bank of Chicago, Bank One Indiana N.A., Bank Boston N.A., Corestates Bank N.A., Suntrust Bank of Central Florida N.A., Bank of Nova Scotia, Credit Lyonnais, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd., and Fuji Bank Ltd.
Brightpoint provides distribution and logistics services to the wireless communications industry.
